title: Arrest Made After Vehicle Pursuit Ends Near Baldwin County School
text:
A suspect was arrested following a vehicle pursuit that ended near Central Baldwin Middle School, prompting a brief lockdown. Deputies used a PIT maneuver to stop the vehicle, and no students or staff were harmed. The lockdown was lifted after the suspect was secured.
BALDWIN COUNTY, Ala. -- An arrest was made following a vehicle pursuit that began in the Summerdale area and ended in front of Central Baldwin Middle School on Wednesday.
The Baldwin County Sheriff's Office says deputies were able to perform a PIT maneuver on the suspect's vehicle. This prevented the vehicle from causing any further risk to the public.
"Because the vehicle came to a stop on school grounds, the campus was briefly placed on lockdown as a precaution while deputies secured the area," the sheriff's office says. According to the sheriff's office, the suspect did not try to enter the school. Students nor staff were in any direct danger.
"Our School Resource Unit worked quickly with school administrators to implement safety protocols," says the sheriff's office. "The lockdown was lifted shortly after the suspect was taken into custody and the scene was secure. "A Severe Thunderstorm Watch is currently in effect for all of our Mississippi and Alabama Counties until 9PM.
